# KissThePDF

> A free, open-source, privacy-first PDF toolkit that runs in-browser without uploads or signup.

## Main

- [KissThePDF — Free, Open-Source, Privacy-First PDF Toolkit](https://www.kissthepdf.space/): Free, open-source PDF tools that run locally in your browser. Merge, split, compress, edit, convert, organize, rotate, protect, and manage PDF files without uploads or signup
